title: Introduce invocation-signal mosaic and anchored log summaries for long-tail SLO debugging
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: long-tail SLO incidents are often caused by correlated micro-patterns across invocation phases and noisy long-lived logs; debugging requires quick aggregation of signal fragments plus compact log summaries. This PR introduces a signal-mosaic aggregator that coalesces per-invocation phase metrics (queue, kernel, kv-cache, token-emit) into a compact multi-dimensional histogram plus an anchored log-summary component that extracts representative log snippets tied to signal spikes. Changes include: 1) signal_mosaic engine that computes per-invocation phase histograms and an outlier fingerprint; 2) anchored-log-summaries module that uses reservoir sampling combined with entropy scoring to pick representative logs for an invocation cohort; 3) new Grafana dashboard panels (mosaic sparkline + log-anchors panel) and a lightweight alert rule that triggers a short-lived debug collection; 4) unit and integration tests plus docs and examples. Checklist: - Implement core aggregator and summarizer; - Add dashboard JSON and display config; - Add alerting rule and feature flag (obs.signal_mosaic.enabled); - Add tests and CI validation; - Add runbook snippet in docs. Links: Linear ENG-2743 for design notes; support ticket SUP-588 for an incident that motivated this work. Backwards compatibility: feature gated; default off for all customers. Rollout plan: enable behind feature flag, canary to internal tenants, monitor cost and storage impact for 48h, then broad enable if no regression.

Includes new Grafana panels and a debug alert that collects short-lived traces and log anchors for SLO investigation. Default off; rollout to internal canary tenants for 48h before wider enablement.
notes_for_oncall: If the new alert floods, flip feature flag obs.signal_mosaic.enabled=false and disable alerting rule alerting/rules/signal_mosaic_debug.yaml. Watch for reservoir_evictions_total spikes indicating memory pressure; if observed, reduce reservoir size via config telemetry.signal_mosaic.reservoir_size.
